AGGRESSIVE_VOLUME_DELTA_PCT.evidence: docs/METRICS_LIBRARY_V1.md documents AGGRESSIVE_VOLUME_DELTA_PCT in F-004 flow normalization; docs/research-v1/.../WEB_RESEARCH_CONFIGURATION_MODEL.md section 3 maps it to methodology/SET.md Part II §§21-23.

ATR percentile.evidence: Metrics Library F-004 outputs ATR_PCT percentile and depends on F-003 for 15m ATR/ATR_PCT; R3 Web Research Configuration Model section 3 maps ATR percentile to methodology/SET.md Part II §§13-15 and §§3-6.

BTC_CONTEXT_SCORE.evidence: Metrics Library F-004 defines BTC_CONTEXT_SCORE and its BTC structure/momentum components; R3 Web Research Configuration Model section 3 maps it to methodology/SET.md Part II BTC context sections.

DE.evidence: Metrics Library F-004 includes DE 15m as a required normalized input and produces DE_STRENGTH/gate diagnostics; R3 section 3 maps DE to methodology/SET.md Part II §§11-12.

RELATIVE_RETURN_15m.evidence: Metrics Library F-004 defines RELATIVE_RETURN_15m = RETURN(asset,15m) - RETURN(BTC,15m) and relative score/veto diagnostics; R3 section 3 maps it to methodology/SET.md Part II §§19-20 and §§3-6.

RETURN(asset,5m).evidence: Metrics Library F-004 local 5m momentum section defines VNM_5m from RETURN_5m / ATR_PCT_decimal_5m; R3 BTC predicates explicitly bind RETURN(asset=BTC,5m) and section 3 maps RETURN(asset,5m) to Set methodology return/context sections.

SWING_SEQUENCE_STATE(asset,1h).evidence: Metrics Library F-004 consumes asset structure 1h/15m and structure score; R3 section 3 maps SWING_SEQUENCE_STATE(asset,1h) to methodology/SET.md Part II §§9-10.

TOD_REL_TURNOVER.evidence: Metrics Library F-004 defines TOD_REL_TURNOVER same-clock turnover ratio and participation strength/activity gate; R3 section 3 maps it to methodology/SET.md Part II §8 and §§21-23.

VNM_5m_z.evidence: Metrics Library F-004 defines VNM_5m/local 5m momentum veto inputs and preserves underlying z-score/availability; R3 section 3 maps VNM_5m_z to methodology/SET.md Part II §§16-18 and numeric policy.

classifier_direction.evidence: Metrics Library F-005 is the Set Direction Classifier and outputs LONG/SHORT/NONE. R3 section 3 lists classifier_direction as an enum state output, not a separate metrics-library metric object.
